remarks: Welcome Home! 1844 Crater Drive in Ventura's desirable East End! This two-story residence offers approximately 1,308sqft  with four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Luxury vinyl plank flooring enhances the downstairs living spaces. One bedroom downstairs and three bedrooms upstairs. Washer and dryer hookups in the kitchen add everyday convenience, and a detached two-car garage provides parking and storage space. Enjoy community amenities including a pool, tennis courts, and playground offering plenty of ways to relax and stay active close to home. Discover the possibilities and make this East Ventura home your own!
